author: /root/dependency_chain
scope: Linux/macOS JDK21 selection, owned runtime/compiler verification, and explicit fixed-version Android dexdump selection in the existing ordinary lane. No application or native iOS execution approval.

inputs.reviewed: Full baseline lane and full delta; AST comparison of every preexisting function.
Complete synthetic fixture and all 21 statically declared test methods; no test execution by reviewer.

findings.result: Darwin retains /usr/libexec/java_home -v 21 with a 15-second bound. Linux requires absolute JAVA_HOME, canonicalizes it, validates a unique major21 release declaration and executable java/javac. No PATH search or unknown-host fallback. Static preflight occurs before evidence/scratch allocation.

Both actual runtime/compiler commands use the existing invoke process-ownership path with 30-second timeouts, inside the existing try/finally. Runtime requires exactly specification version21 and canonical matching java.home; compiler requires unique major21. Nonzero, oversized, missing, duplicate, or mismatched output fails closed. Successful receipt binds both raw logs by SHA256; failure still reaches Gradle stop and exact scratch/output finalization.

Explicit ANDROID_HOME/ANDROID_SDK_ROOT must be absolute and agree after canonicalization. Only Darwin may use the historical home-directory fallback. Fixed build-tools36.0.0 executable dexdump remains mandatory. This selector runs only when actual AAB inspection needs it; ordinary JVM/command lanes do not acquire an unnecessary SDK prerequisite. Artifact validation and digest equality are unchanged.

AST-identical preexisting functions: collect_reports, identity, inspect_generated_artifacts, invoke, now, owned_outputs, processes, runner_identity, stop_owned_workers, track_processes. Main retains the same nonblocking lock, preexisting-output/daemon refusals, strict verification/no-daemon/no-parallel/one-worker flags, source/control equality, mandatory stop and exact cleanup/status predicates. No cache deletion, signing credential access, publication or protocol/application change.

Synthetic executable placeholders are never launched; module import only defines the lane. Tests cover no-fallback selection, explicit aliases, major17/210/garbage/duplicate rejection, bounded matching runtime/compiler, conflicting SDK roots, fixed tool version, and actual main control flow for static rejection before allocation and runtime-probe rejection reaching stop/cleanup. Main integration test mocks process/tool execution, not the finally block. These are control tests, not JDK/application-runtime evidence.

corrections_during_review: Author initially described 22 tests; independent AST count is 21 unique test_ methods. Author/coordinator informed before execution; no source change required.

This modified lane needs a fresh exact lane hash in later candidate/export bindings. Historical outer receipts are not relabeled as execution of these bytes.
Actual Android AAB inspection on Linux and hosted macOS/iOS work are not established by this source approval.
